dev-caches.npm.name: npm's download cache
dev-caches.npm.what: Copies of the packages npm downloaded, so the next install needs no download.
dev-caches.npm.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and the packages in them keep working.
dev-caches.npm.comes-back: Yes, npm downloads each package again when a project needs it.
dev-caches.yarn.name: Yarn's download cache
dev-caches.yarn.what: Copies of the packages Yarn downloaded, so the next install needs no download.
dev-caches.yarn.made-by: Yarn, a package manager for JavaScript.
dev-caches.yarn.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and the packages in them keep working.
dev-caches.yarn.comes-back: Yes, Yarn downloads each package again when a project needs it.
dev-caches.homebrew.name: Homebrew's downloads
dev-caches.homebrew.what: Packages and apps Homebrew downloaded to install them; once installed, they are not needed.
dev-caches.homebrew.made-by: Homebrew, a tool that installs apps and command-line tools.
dev-caches.homebrew.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Everything Homebrew installed keeps working.
dev-caches.homebrew.comes-back: Only when Homebrew installs or upgrades something; it also clears old downloads on its own.
dev-caches.cargo.name: Cargo's download cache
dev-caches.cargo.what: Rust libraries Cargo downloaded, so the next build needs no download.
dev-caches.cargo.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and the programs you installed with Cargo stay.
dev-caches.cargo.comes-back: Yes, Cargo downloads each one again when a project builds with it.
dev-caches.cocoapods.name: CocoaPods' download cache
dev-caches.cocoapods.what: Copies of the libraries CocoaPods downloaded for iOS and macOS projects.
dev-caches.cocoapods.made-by: CocoaPods, a tool that adds libraries to iOS and macOS projects.
dev-caches.cocoapods.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects keep the libraries already in them.
dev-caches.cocoapods.comes-back: Yes, CocoaPods downloads each library again when a project needs it.
dev-caches.gradle.name: Gradle's caches
dev-caches.gradle.line: Files Gradle keeps to build faster
dev-caches.gradle.what: Libraries Gradle downloaded and files it prepared for Java, Kotlin and Android builds.
dev-caches.gradle.made-by: Gradle, the build tool of Java, Kotlin and Android projects.
dev-caches.gradle.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and Gradle's settings stay.
dev-caches.gradle.comes-back: Yes, with the next build, which takes longer and needs the network.
dev-caches.pip.name: pip's download cache
dev-caches.pip.what: Copies of the Python packages pip downloaded or built, so the next install is faster.
dev-caches.pip.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and the packages in them keep working.
dev-caches.pip.comes-back: Yes, pip downloads each package again when it installs it.
dev-caches.go-build.name: Go's build cache
dev-caches.go-build.line: Files Go keeps to build faster
dev-caches.go-build.what: Compiled pieces of Go programs, so the next build only compiles what changed.
dev-caches.go-build.made-by: The Go tools, on every build or test.
dev-caches.go-build.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your code and the programs you built stay.
dev-caches.go-build.comes-back: Yes, with the next build, which is slower once.
dev-caches.xcode-derived-data.name: Xcode build data
dev-caches.xcode-derived-data.what: What Xcode makes while it builds a project: compiled files, its code index and build logs.
dev-caches.xcode-derived-data.made-by: Xcode, Apple's app for making apps.
dev-caches.xcode-derived-data.if-removed: Nothing is lost. Your projects and their code stay.
dev-caches.xcode-derived-data.comes-back: Yes, Xcode makes it again on the next build, which is slower once.
dev-caches.enabled.label: Developer caches
dev-caches.enabled.description: Finds the download caches of package managers and Xcode's build data. The tools make them again.
dev-caches.finding.reason-download: {tool} downloads it again when it needs it.
dev-caches.finding.reason-build: {tool} builds it again when it needs it.
dev-caches.left-out.not-yours: Some of it belongs to macOS or another user, or is locked, so only an administrator can remove it.
dev-caches.left-out.special: A running program may be using it, so it is kept.
dev-caches.left-out.app-open: Its app is open and writes here as it works. Quit the app and scan again.
dev-caches.left-out.no-system: Fresher could not list your open apps, so it keeps this. Scan again.
